1. (Currently Amended) A gas generator comprising: a composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total composition; and a desiccant in __thermal stability-enhancing__ operable communication with said composition.

2. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition, __and said composition maintains thermal stability during aging. __

3. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, and said desiccant is provided in amounts resulting in a mass differential of about -5.0 to 5.0% of the composition after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours, __improving the stability of the gas generant composition.__

4. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said composition contains an extrusion aid provided at about 0.1-10 weight percent of the total gas generant composition, __and enhances processing characteristics. __

5. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 4 wherein said extrusion aid is selected from graphite, fumed silica, and mixtures thereof, __preferably including a stabilizer to enhance properties.__

6. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate, __which is an effective oxidizer for gas generation.__

7. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, __providing effective fuel performance.__

8. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is DL-tartaric acid, __which is advantageous for certain applications. __ 

9. (Currently Amended) A gas generating system comprising: a gas generator comprising a composition, said composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and said composition further containing a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition; and a desiccant in __thermal stability-enhancing__ operable communication with said composition.

10. (Currently Amended) The gas generating system of claim 9 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition, __which contributes to the overall efficiency. __

11. (Currently Amended) The gas generating system of claim 9 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, and __contributes positively to the thermal stability of the gas generating system.__

12. (Currently Amended) The gas generating system of claim 9 wherein said system is a vehicle occupant protection system, __providing enhanced safety features. __

13. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising: an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent; a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent; and a desiccant provided at about 5-35 weight percent, __contributing to the overall efficiency and stability of the gas generant composition.__

14. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, DL-tartaric acid, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, __tailoring the performance for specific applications.__

15. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate, __confirming the oxidizing qualities of said composition.__

16. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide, __providing various options for enhancing performance.__

17. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is zeolite, __which is particularly effective for moisture control.__

18. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected to provide a mass differential of about -5.0% to 5.0% after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours, __indicating stable performance during extended use.__
